<article title="Password reset and sign-in help">
To reset your password, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter the email address on your account. The reset link arrives within a few minutes and stays valid for one hour. If you do not see it, check your spam folder and confirm you used the email address the account was created with.

After five failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Waiting out the lock and then resetting your password clears it.

If you use two-factor authentication and no longer have your device, we can remove the second factor after verifying your identity with the billing address and the last four digits of the payment card on file.

</article>

Customer first name: Luis
<request>
cannot log in
i keep getting 'invalid credentials' when i log in. i am sure the password is right. can you reset it?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Luis,

I'd be happy to help you regain access to your account. To reset your password, click "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter the email address associated with your account. You'll receive a reset link within a few minutes—just check your spam folder if you don't see it. The link stays valid for one hour.

If you've had five failed sign-in attempts, your account may be locked for 30 minutes. Waiting out the lock and then resetting your password will clear it.

If you need further assistance, a specialist will follow up with you.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
